action_items: Investigate demo wallet drift: demo distributor now shows available=0 / pending=1000 instead of the documented 500/500. Either seed the wallet snapshot deterministically (upsert wallet doc directly) or make demo_seed idempotent so re-runs don't double-count the PENDING WITHDRAWAL entry. WDDEMO001 pending withdrawal itself is fine.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/auth_routes.py PUT /profile/photo: 4MB check uses byte-length of the string, which for a base64 data URI overstates the actual image size by ~33%. Acceptable but consider decoding to check true byte size, and add server-side MIME sniffing to prevent HTML/JS smuggling in data:image/* URIs.
backend/auth_routes.py PUT /profile/photo: no audit log call — every other user mutation logs via log_audit; add for consistency.
